name: Pinellas County, FL
findings: Pinellas County has 3,243 nonprofit organizations. 1,275 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 992 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pinellas County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 44 housing organizations here list public events, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few union organizations list membership
observations.text: 8 union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 26 would.

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through union groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Pinellas County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 255 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 255 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
